create_pipeline_sdxl_controlnet_referenc: create a StableDiffusionXLControlNetReferencePipeline for text-to-image generation with ControlNet and reference image guidance
run_pipeline_sdxl_controlnet_reference: run the StableDiffusionXLControlNetReferencePipeline with a prompt, control image, and reference image to generate styled images
prepare_ref_latents_pipeline: prepare reference image latents by encoding a reference image through the VAE for reference control guidance
prepare_ref_image_pipeline: prepare and preprocess a reference image by resizing, normalizing, and converting it to a torch tensor for reference control
check_ref_inputs_pipeline: validate reference control inputs including ref image type, reference_attn or reference_adain flags, style fidelity, and guidance ranges
